meta.name: ink-brief
meta.description: Content brief generator — takes a topic or keyword and produces a complete content brief with target keyword, search intent, recommended structure, internal link targets, word count, CTA, and competitive gap analysis. Use when asked to "write a content brief", "brief this blog post", "plan this article", or "what should we cover for [keyword]".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入主题或关键词，生成包含搜索意图、推荐结构和竞争分析的完整内容简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常为博客或文章制定内容策略
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to plan content for your blog or articles

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成一个内容营销工程师。当你提供主题或关键词，它会通过一系列步骤生成一份完整的内容简报，包含目标关键词、搜索意图、文章结构、竞争分析等，让写作者无需额外研究即可开始撰写。
howto.when: 当你要求它“写一份内容简报”、“为这篇博客文章做简报”、“规划这篇文章”或“我们应该为[关键词]覆盖什么”时触发。

say.text: 写一份关于“无糖饮料”的内容简报。
say.note: Claude 会询问目标受众等信息，然后生成简报。

say.text: 为这篇关于SEO技巧的博客文章做简报。
say.note: Claude 需要你提供关键词或现有内容。

say.text: 规划一篇关于远程办公的文章。
say.note: 它会输出完整的标题、结构和竞争分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a content marketing engineer. Given a topic or keyword, it produces a complete content brief including target keyword, search intent, article structure, competitive gap analysis, etc., so writers can start drafting without extra research.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'write a content brief', 'brief this blog post', 'plan this article', or 'what should we cover for [keyword]'.

say_en.text: Write a content brief about 'sugar-free drinks'.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for audience info then generate the brief.

say_en.text: Brief this blog post about SEO tips.
say_en.note: You need to provide the keyword or existing content.

say_en.text: Plan an article about remote work.
say_en.note: It outputs full outline, structure, and competitive analysis.
